Dataview
========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page May 20, 2026 · [88 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview/_history)

**Dataview** items run Dataview queries, evaluate expressions, and execute scripts (like with `dv.view`).

*   Note Toolbar's _Scripting_ option must be enabled in order to use this feature.
*   The [Dataview plugin ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=dataview)
     must also be installed _and enabled_.

Examples
--------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#examples)

See the `examples` folder in this repo for [example scripts ↗](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts/Dataview)
 that work with Note Toolbar.

See also the [Example Vault for Dataview Queries ↗](https://github.com/s-blu/obsidian_dataview_example_vault)
 and the [Basic Dataview Query Builder ↗](https://s-blu.github.io/basic-dataview-query-builder/)
 thanks to @s-blu.

Use Dataview expressions in any toolbar item
--------------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#use-dataview-expressions-in-any-toolbar-item)

You can use Dataview expressions in labels, tooltips, and URIs, to create dynamic toolbars. (Dataview JS expressions are not supported.)

For example, set your label or tooltip to:

*   `=dateformat(date(today), "MMM d")` to show today's date, right in your toolbar (assuming your Dataview prefix is set to `=`); alternately use this syntax: `{{dv: dateformat(date(today), "MMM d")}}`
*   `{{dv: durationformat(dur(this.somedateproperty - date(today)), "d") }}` to show the number of days from today to some date property in the note

Functions available
-------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#functions-available)

After creating a new `Dataview` toolbar item, select from one of the below functions.

### `Execute query`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#execute-query)

*   Executes the provided query and renders the result.
*   Uses the `queryMarkdown` API method.

_Query example:_

```sql
TABLE file.mtime AS "Last Modified" 
FROM "SomeFolder" 
SORT file.mtime DESC
```

### `Execute JavaScript file`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#execute-javascript-file)

*   Executes the provided script file, much like `dv.view()` (but missing the CSS features).
*   Parameters can be passed in JSON format, e.g., `"name": "Chris"`

_JavaScript file example:_

```js
dv.paragraph("👋 Hello note!"); // must use Output callout ID for this to appear
console.log("👋 Hello console!");
new Notice("👋 Hello notice!");
```

_JavaScript file with parameters:_

```js
(async () => {
    let name
    if (input) {
        ({name} = input)
    }
    console.log(`👋 Hello ${name}`);
    new Notice(`👋 Hello ${name}`);
})();
```

_JavaScript file with parameters, with Dataview output:_

```js
// Shows a list of files in the specified folder (and subfolders).
// Excludes the current file. Defaults to current folder if folder not provided. Sorts alphabetically.
function FileList(input) {
    let fileFolder

    if (input) {
        ({fileFolder} = input)
    }
    /* if fileFolder is not provided... */
    else {
        /* ...default to the folder of the calling note */
        fileFolder = dv.current().file.folder
    }

    const files = app.vault.getFiles()
        .filter(file => file.path.startsWith(
            fileFolder.endsWith("/") ? fileFolder : fileFolder + `/`) && 
            (file.path !== dv.current().file.path))
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

    dv.paragraph("📂 `" + fileFolder + "`:")
    dv.list(files.map(file => dv.fileLink(file.path)))
}

FileList(input)
```

### `Evaluate Dataview expression`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#evaluate-dataview-expression)

*   Interprets the provided Dataview expression and returns the result.
*   Uses the `evaluateInline` API method.

_Dataview expression example:_

```js
dateformat(this.file.mtime, "yyyy.MM.dd - HH:mm")
```

### `Evaluate Dataview JS expression`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#evaluate-dataview-js-expression)

*   Interprets the provided Dataview JS expression and returns the result.
*   Uses the `executeJs` API method.

_Dataview JS expression example:_

```js
dv.el('p', dv.current().file.mtime)
```

Note Toolbar Callout support
----------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#note-toolbar-callout-support)

For Note Toolbar Callouts, use these data attributes:

| Function | `data-dataview` | `data-expr` | `data-src` | `data-args` | `data-callout` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Execute query | `query` | query | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | callout ID (_optional_) |
| Execute script | `exec` | _n/a_ | script filename | arguments (_optional_) | callout ID (_optional_) |
| Evaluate Dataview expression | `evaluate` | expression | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | callout ID (_optional_) |
| Evaluate Dataview JS expression | `executeJs` | expression | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | callout ID (_optional_) |

Example:

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Dataview Toolbar
> - [Dataview Query Example]()<data data-dataview="query" data-expr="TABLE file.mtime AS &quot;Last Modified&quot; FROM &quot;Templater&quot; SORT file.mtime DESC" data-callout="asf"/>
```

Advanced settings
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#advanced-settings)

Clicking on the gear (⚙️) icon opens advanced options:

### Output callout ID

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#output-callout-id)

Use this to create a callout for where script output can be sent.

See [Executing scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts#where-does-output-go)
, which also covers how errors are handled.

### Focus in editor

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#focus-in-editor)

After a script is executed, focus is placed in the editor by default. If set to `false`, it won't be.

This is useful for scripts that don't have an impact on the content of your notes, such as opening a menu with the [`ntb.menu` API](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#menu)
.

* * *

### Learn more: [Executing scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts)

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview#learn-more-executing-scripts)

Note Toolbar
============

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar#note-toolbar)

**[English](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/blob/master/README.md)
 | [中文文档](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/blob/master/README-ZH.md)
 | [日本語](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/blob/master/README-JA.md)
**

The [Note Toolbar plugin](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=note-toolbar)
 for [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md/)
 lets you create context-aware toolbars for your notes, which can include commands, file and folder links, websites/URIs, menus, and scripts (Dataview, Templater, and JavaScript).

> What's new? See the [Release Notes](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/releases)
> 
> What's ahead? See the [Roadmap](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Roadmap)

Disclosures
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar#disclosures)

In order for Note Toolbar to provide a built-in library of helpful tools, and scripting extensibility, the plugin needs access to read, write, and list files within a vault. _The majority of these features are completely optional._

Expand below to see what's accessed and why. Let me know (via [GitHub ↗](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/issues/546)
 or [Google form ↗](https://forms.gle/sa75KNAQiWTtAY4P8)
) if you have any questions or concerns.

See disclosures...  

*   **Uses Obsidian APIs newer than the declared minAppVersion**

*   The plugin uses some internal Obsidian APIs. This warning is indicating that some of those APIs _will_ be public in a newer release, and should go away then.

*   **Vault Read: Reads individual vault files via the Obsidian API**

*   Used by script items to read in a user script to execute it (if configured to do so).
*   Used in Note Toolbar's `modal` API to display a file.

*   **Vault Enumeration: Enumerates all files in the vault. Gives the plugin access to every file path in the vault.**

*   Used by the Settings UI to show a list of files or folders in the vault (e.g., to select a script file, or to select a folder for mapping).

*   **Other notes**

*   URLs links from the plugin are used for: the user guide, donation page, and for a page to facilitate [sharing of toolbars or toolbar items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars)
     with other users ([source code](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/gh-pages/docs)
    ). See the documentation in [`src/utils/Urls.ts`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/blob/master/src/Utils/Urls.ts)
    , which contains all external URLs referenced by the plugin.

Note that all Gallery item scripts can be inspected (and modified) after adding them to any toolbar.

Features
--------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar#features)

_🏆 Runner up in the Obsidian Gems of the Year 2024: New plugins category._

*   [Create toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-toolbars)
     with items that link to commands, files/folders, URIs/URLs, menus, and [scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts)
     (Dataview, JS Engine, Templater, and built-in support for JavaScript).
    *   Built-in [Gallery of 100+ items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
         that can be added to your toolbars in just a couple clicks/taps.
*   [Define where and how toolbars are displayed](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Defining-where-to-show-toolbars)
    : Based on their folders, or a user-defined property.
    *   [Position each toolbar](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars)
         below the Properties section, at the top or bottom of notes, in the tab bar, or as a floating button.
    *   [Show a toolbar when text is selected.](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Toolbars-within-the-app#Selected-text)
        
    *   Access the toolbar from [the ribbon](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon)
        , and from [navigation bars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars)
         (on mobile).
    *   Add a toolbar to the _New tab_ view, or [completely replace the New tab view](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Toolbars-within-the-app#New-tab-view)
         as a launchpad for your vault.
    *   Right-click (or long press) toolbars to swap with others, quickly change their position, style, or to access configuration.
*   Use Obsidian's built-in icons, labels (which can include emojis), or a mix of both.
    *   Show items specifically on mobile, desktop, or both.
    *   Choose whether the icon, label, or both are displayed.
    *   Set optional tooltips for each item.
*   [Style toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Styling-toolbars)
     by adding borders, sticking to the top of your note on scroll, auto-hiding, choosing whether or not the toolbar should wrap (on mobile), making items look like buttons or act like tabs, and aligning items (left, right, centered, evenly spaced).
    *   Change or override toolbar styles on mobile (i.e, phone and tablet).
    *   Or use the [Style Settings plugin](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
         for even more options (colors, positioning, sizing, etc.).
*   [Note Toolbar Callouts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-Callouts)
     let you create and place toolbars anywhere within your notes.
*   Add [commands](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Commands)
     to open any toolbar, or to execute any item. Built-in commands _completely_ hide note properties, quickly access toolbars with [Quick Tools](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools)
    , get command URIs, and more.
*   Use [variables](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Variables)
     or script expressions to sub in the note's title or properties and more into toolbar item labels, tooltips, and URIs.
*   [Note Toolbar URIs](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-URIs)
     let you execute commands, focus on folders, open menus (within Note Toolbar Callouts), and open toolbar settings, from mostly anywhere within your notes.
*   [Keyboard controls](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility)
     available via the _Note Toolbar: Focus_ command
*   [Share toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars)
     with other users with a link, or [as callouts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-callouts-from-toolbars)
    .
*   The [Note Toolbar CLI](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI)
     provides command-line access to create Note Toolbar toolbars and items, using Obsidian's CLI.
*   The [Note Toolbar API](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API)
     provides toolbar access, and the ability to show UI (suggesters, prompts, menus, and modals). The latter enables Dataview JS, JS Engine, or Templater scripts to ask for information, or to show helpful text.

Installation
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar#installation)

[Click here](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/note-toolbar)
 or:

1.  Open Obsidian's settings, and click _Community plugins_
2.  Search for _Note Toolbar_ and select it
3.  _Install_
4.  Make sure to _Enable_ the plugin

Installing beta versions via BRAT  
[BRAT](https://github.com/TfTHacker/obsidian42-brat)
 lets you beta-test plugins, to provide feedback.  
  
As beta versions become available, I welcome [your feedback](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions)
 and any [issues](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/issues)
 you uncover!  
  
_Disclaimer: Betas are pre-release versions of the plugin. It is strongly encouraged to make a backup of your Note Toolbar's `data.json` file before proceeding, and/or test within a separate vault (depending on the nature of the beta)._  
  

> 1.  Install the BRAT plugin:
>     *   Open _Settings > Community Plugins_
>     *   _Disable safe mode_, if enabled
>     *   Browse, and _search for "BRAT"_
>     *   Install the latest version of _BRAT_
> 2.  Open BRAT settings (_Settings -> BRAT_)
> 3.  Scroll to the _Beta plugin list_ section
> 4.  _Add beta plugin_
> 5.  Specify this repository: `chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar`
> 6.  _Enable the Note Toolbar plugin_ (_Settings -> Community plugins_)
> 7.  In Note Toolbar's settings, confirm the version number at the top is the latest beta version. You may need to restart Obsidian, or re-open your vault.

Getting Started 🚀
------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar#getting-started-)

Once enabled, open Note Toolbar's settings:

1.  Create a _\+ New toolbar_
2.  Give the toolbar a _name_.
3.  _\+ Add_ (or search the [Gallery](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
    )
4.  Exit settings, and _open a note_.
5.  Add a `notetoolbar` property. Set it to the name of your toolbar.

If you want your toolbar to show _without_ using a property, try mapping a folder (like wherever your Daily Notes are stored) to your new toolbar.

Additional Gallery items
========================

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jul 14, 2026 · [75 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items/_history)

This page provides more examples of items to add to your toolbars that make use of the clipboard, and reading/writing files within your vault. Review the scripts before adding these items to a toolbar.

Important

If you're viewing this page within Obsidian's web viewer, the **Add this item** button will not work. Right-click on the page and select _Open in default browser_.

Instructions
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#instructions)

For each item you would like to add, use the **Add this item** button, or:

1.  Create a **JavaScript** type item (unless otherwise noted)
2.  Select **Evaluate JavaScript**
3.  Copy/Paste the script, shown under each item below

* * *

Clipboard
---------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#clipboard)

Move note text to and from the clipboard, for use in other applications.

### Copy to clipboard

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#copy-to-clipboard)

Copies the selected text to the clipboard.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiClipboardCopy%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20e%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view%3F.editor%3B%20try%20%7B%20await%20activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.getSelection())%3B%20e%3F.focus()%3B%20%7D%20catch%20(e)%20%7B%20console.error(e)%3B%20new%20Notice(%27Error%3A%20Please%20check%20console%20for%20details%27)%3B%20%7D%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Copy%20--%3E)

`View script...``   ```js const e = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; try {    await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.getSelection());   e?.focus();  }  catch (e) {    console.error(e);    new Notice('Error: Please check console for details');  } ```   `

### Cut to clipboard

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#cut-to-clipboard)

Cuts the selected text to the clipboard.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiScissors%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20e%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view%3F.editor%3B%20try%20%7B%20await%20activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.getSelection())%3B%20e.replaceSelection(%27%27)%3B%20e%3F.focus()%3B%20%7D%20catch%20(e)%20%7B%20console.error(e)%3B%20new%20Notice(%27Error%3A%20Please%20check%20console%20for%20details%27)%3B%20%7D%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Cut%20--%3E)

`View script...``   ```js const e = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; try {    await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.getSelection());    e.replaceSelection('');    e?.focus();  }  catch (e) {    console.error(e);    new Notice('Error: Please check console for details');  } ```   `

### Paste from clipboard

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#paste-from-clipboard)

Pastes the text from the clipboard into your note.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiClipboardPaste%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20e%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view%3F.editor%3B%20try%20%7B%20let%20rs%20%3D%20e.replaceSelection%3B%20let%20text%20%3D%20await%20activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.readText()%3B%20if%20(text)%20rs.apply(e%2C%20%5Btext%5D)%3B%20e%3F.focus()%3B%20%7D%20catch%20(e)%20%7B%20console.error(e)%3B%20new%20Notice(%27Error%3A%20Please%20check%20console%20for%20details%27)%3B%20%7D%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Paste%20--%3E)

`View script...``   ```js const e = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; try {    let rs = e.replaceSelection;   let text = await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.readText();   if (text) rs.apply(e, [text]); e?.focus(); } catch (e) {    console.error(e);   new Notice('Error: Please check console for details'); } ```   `

### Copy link to block

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#copy-link-to-block)

Copies a [link to the current block ↗](https://obsidian.md/help/links#Link+to+a+block+in+a+note)
 to the clipboard, if there is one.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiLink2%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20editor%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.activeEditor%3F.editor%3B%20const%20file%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.getActiveFile()%3B%20const%20line%20%3D%20editor%3F.getCursor().line%3B%20const%20blockId%20%3D%20editor%3F.getLine(line).match(%2F%5C%5E(%5B%5Cw-%5D%2B)%2F)%3F.%5B1%5D%20%3F%3F%20app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file)%3F.blocks%3F.%5Bline%5D%3F.id%3B%20if%20(blockId)%20%7B%20window.navigator.clipboard.writeText(%60%5B%5B%24%7Bfile.path%7D%23%5E%24%7BblockId%7D%5D%5D%60)%3B%20new%20Notice(%27Copied%20to%20clipboard%27)%3B%20%7D%20else%20%7B%20new%20Notice(%27No%20block%20ID%20found%27)%3B%20%7D%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Copy%20link%20to%20block%20--%3E)

`View script...```   ```js const editor = ntb.app.workspace.activeEditor?.editor; const file = ntb.app.workspace.getActiveFile(); const line = editor?.getCursor().line;  const blockId =     editor?.getLine(line).match(/\^([\w-]+)/)?.[1] ??     app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file)?.blocks?.[line]?.id;  if (blockId) {     window.navigator.clipboard.writeText(`[[${file.path}#^${blockId}]]`);     new Notice('Copied to clipboard'); } else {     new Notice('No block ID found'); } ```   ``

### Copy note content

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#copy-note-content)

Copy body of the note to the clipboard, ignoring frontmatter.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiClipboardCheck%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20editor%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view%3F.editor%3B%20if%20(!editor)%20return%3B%20const%20body%20%3D%20editor%20.getValue()%20.replace(%2F%5E---%5Cn%5B%5Cs%5CS%5D*%3F%5Cn---%5Cn*%2F%2C%20%27%27)%3B%20await%20activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(body)%3B%20new%20Notice(%27Copied%20to%20clipboard%27)%3B%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Copy%20note%20content%20--%3E)

`View script...``   ```js const editor = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; if (!editor) return;  const body = editor     .getValue()     .replace(/^---\n[\s\S]*?\n---\n*/, '');  await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(body); new Notice('Copied to clipboard'); ```   `

### Paste external embed

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#paste-external-embed)

Add an embedded external link. Checks the clipboard for a valid media link first (defined in the list of allowed hosts), otherwise prompts for a link.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiImagePlay%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22let%20url%20%3D%20%27%27%3B%20try%20%7B%20url%20%3D%20(await%20activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.readText()).trim()%3B%20%7D%20catch%20%7B%7D%20const%20allowedHosts%20%3D%20%5B%27youtube%27%5D%3B%20const%20isAllowed%20%3D%20(u)%20%3D%26gt%3B%20%7B%20if%20(!URL.canParse(u))%20return%20false%3B%20const%20host%20%3D%20new%20URL(u).hostname%3B%20return%20allowedHosts.some(h%20%3D%26gt%3B%20host.includes(h))%3B%20%7D%3B%20if%20(!isAllowed(url))%20%7B%20url%20%3D%20(await%20ntb.prompt(%7B%20placeholder%3A%20%27Paste%20a%20supported%20media%20URL%27%20%7D))%20%3F%3F%20%27%27%3B%20%7D%20if%20(isAllowed(url))%20ntb.setSelection(%60!%5B%5D(%24%7Burl%7D)%60)%3B%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Paste%20external%20embed%20--%3E)

`View script...```   ```js let url = '';  try { url = (await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.readText()).trim(); } catch {}  const allowedHosts = ['youtube'];  const isAllowed = (u) => {     if (!URL.canParse(u)) return false;     const host = new URL(u).hostname;     return allowedHosts.some(h => host.includes(h)); };  if (!isAllowed(url)) {     url = (await ntb.prompt({ placeholder: 'Paste a supported media URL' })) ?? ''; }  if (isAllowed(url)) ntb.setSelection(`![](${url})`); ```   ``

Files
-----

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#files)

Tools for working with files.

### Append text to file

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#append-text-to-file)

Appends the prompted text to a file you specify.

```js
const filePath = 'File.md'; // CHANGE THIS TO ANY FILE

const file = ntb.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(filePath);
if (!file) {
    new Notice('File does not exist');
    return;
}

const text = await ntb.prompt({ large: true });
if (!text) return;

const content = await ntb.app.vault.read(file);
await ntb.app.vault.modify(file, `${content}\n\n${text}`);
```

### Open file in new tab

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#open-file-in-new-tab)

Opens the selected file in a new tab and switches to it.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiFilePlus%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20file%20%3D%20await%20ntb.fileSuggester(%20ntb.app.vault.getAllLoadedFiles()%2C%20%7Bfilesonly%3A%20true%7D%20)%3B%20if%20(file)%20%7B%20const%20leaf%20%3D%20ntb.app.workspace.getLeaf(true)%3B%20await%20leaf.openFile(file)%3B%20ntb.app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf%2C%20%7Bfocus%3A%20true%7D)%3B%20%7D%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Open%20file%20in%20new%20tab%20--%3E)

`View script...``   ```js const file = await ntb.fileSuggester(   ntb.app.vault.getAllLoadedFiles(),   {filesonly: true} ); if (file) {   const leaf = ntb.app.workspace.getLeaf(true);   await leaf.openFile(file);   ntb.app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf, {focus: true}); } ```   `

### Display file list

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#display-file-list)

🧩 Requires the [Dataview ↗](https://github.com/blacksmithgu/obsidian-dataview)
 plugin.

Shows a list of files in the specified folder (and subfolders), in the current note. Excludes the current file. Defaults to current folder if folder not provided. Sorts alphabetically.

**Instructions**

1.  Paste this script into a .js file in your vault.
2.  Create a **Dataview** type item.
3.  Select **Execute JavaScript file**.
4.  Enter the script below.
5.  In the **Arguments** field, enter: `fileFolder: "Scripts"` where "Scripts" is the name of the folder you want to list files for.
6.  Add a **Note Toolbar Output Callout** and **add its ID under Advanced settings** ([instructions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts#output-callout)
    ) to render the output in.

```js
function FileList(input) {
    let fileFolder;

    if (input) {
        ({fileFolder} = input);
    }
    /* if fileFolder is not provided... */
    else {
        /* ...default to the folder of the calling note */
        fileFolder = dv.current().file.folder;
    }
    fileFolder = fileFolder ?? "";

    const files = app.vault.getFiles()
        .filter(file => (fileFolder === ""
            ? !file.path.includes("/")
            : file.path.startsWith(
                fileFolder.endsWith("/") ? fileFolder : fileFolder + "/"))
            && file.path !== dv.current().file.path)
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    dv.paragraph("📂 `" + fileFolder + "`:");
    dv.list(files.map(file => dv.fileLink(file.path)));
}

FileList(input);
```

Note Toolbar
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#note-toolbar)

### Backup Note Toolbar data

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#backup-note-toolbar-data)

Copies Note Toolbar's settings (data.json) file into the vault.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiFileStack%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20src%20%3D%20%60%24%7Bntb.app.vault.configDir%7D%2Fplugins%2Fnote-toolbar%2Fdata.json%60%3B%20const%20date%20%3D%20new%20Date().toISOString().slice(0%2C%2010).replace(%2F-%2Fg%2C%20%27%27)%3B%20const%20dest%20%3D%20%60note-toolbar-%24%7Bdate%7D-data.json%60%3B%20ntb.app.vault.adapter.read(src).then(data%20%3D%26gt%3B%20%7B%20ntb.app.vault.adapter.write(dest%2C%20data)%3B%20new%20Notice(%60Created%3A%20%24%7Bdest%7D%60)%3B%20%7D)%3B%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Backup%20Note%20Toolbar%20data%20--%3E)

`View script...```   ```js const src = `${ntb.app.vault.configDir}/plugins/note-toolbar/data.json`; const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, ''); const dest = `note-toolbar-${date}-data.json`;  ntb.app.vault.adapter.read(src).then(data => {    ntb.app.vault.adapter.write(dest, data);    new Notice(`Created: ${dest}`);  }); ```   ``

### Export all toolbars to callouts

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items#export-all-toolbars-to-callouts)

Writes an export file containing all toolbars as callouts.

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/80e54b7ad6a8a99484690699e7f1e637f8ec0c7dbd4919133ac73818262d0999/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f416464253230746869732532306974656d2d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this item to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiForm%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-javascript%3D%22evaluate%22%20data-expr%3D%22const%20toolbars%20%3D%20ntb.getToolbars()%3B%20let%20callouts%20%3D%20%27%27%3B%20for%20(let%20toolbar%20of%20toolbars)%20%7B%20callouts%20%2B%3D%20%60%23%23%20%24%7Btoolbar.getName()%7D%5Cn%5Cn%60%3B%20callouts%20%2B%3D%20await%20ntb.export(toolbar)%3B%20callouts%20%2B%3D%20%27%5Cn%27%3B%20%7D%20const%20datestamp%20%3D%20new%20Date().toISOString().replace(%2F%5B%3A.%5D%2Fg%2C%20%27%27).replace(%27T%27%2C%20%27-%27).split(%27Z%27)%5B0%5D%3B%20const%20filename%20%3D%20%60TOOLBARS%20%24%7Bdatestamp%7D.md%60%3B%20await%20ntb.app.vault.create(filename%2C%20callouts)%3B%20new%20Notice(%60Toolbars%20exported%20to%3A%5Cn%24%7Bfilename%7D%60)%3B%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Export%20all%20toolbars%20as%20callouts%20--%3E)

`View script...```   ```js const toolbars = ntb.getToolbars(); let callouts = '';  for (let toolbar of toolbars) {     callouts += `## ${toolbar.getName()}\n\n`;     callouts += await ntb.export(toolbar);     callouts += '\n'; }  const datestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '').replace('T', '-').split('Z')[0]; const filename = `TOOLBARS ${datestamp}.md`; await ntb.app.vault.create(filename, callouts);  new Notice(`Toolbars exported to:\n${filename}`); ```   ``

Note Toolbar CLI
================

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Aug 17, 2026 · [93 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI/_history)

> Available in `1.31+`

The **Note Toolbar CLI** provides command-line access to create [Note Toolbar](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/)
 toolbars and items, using [Obsidian's CLI ↗](https://obsidian.md/help/cli)
. This lets you control Note Toolbar from your terminal for scripting, automation, and integration with external tools.

Note

Out of an abundance of caution, deletion of items and toolbars is currently not supported in the CLI. Perhaps such commands will be added if there is a clean way to undo these actions (for which currently there is not).

Get started
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#get-started)

Read the [Obsidian CLI ↗](https://obsidian.md/help/cli)
 documentation to install, enable, and get familiar with how Obsidian's command-line interface works.

Important

Access to the CLI requires Obsidian 1.12 (and the installer for that version) or later, as well as Note Toolbar 1.31 or later.

Examples
--------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#examples)

```shell
# List toolbars
obsidian note-toolbar

# List items in a toolbar
obsidian note-toolbar toolbar="Daily Notes"

# Create a toolbar
obsidian note-toolbar:new name=Formatting

# Add an item to a toolbar
obsidian note-toolbar:add-command to=Formatting label=Bold command=editor:toggle-bold

# Use an item
obsidian note-toolbar:use item=c0a21325-b8b1-4617-81a0-5114350310fc
```

How to
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#how-to)

### Provide files to commands

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#provide-files-to-commands)

Some commands accept file and path parameters to target a specific file (for example for executing script files).

*   `file=<name>` resolves the file using the same link resolution as [wikilinks ↗](https://obsidian.md/help/links)
    , matching by file name without requiring the full path or extension.
*   `path=<path>` requires the exact path from the vault root, `e.g. folder/script.js`.

### Provide icons to commands

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#provide-icons-to-commands)

When adding an icon for a toolbar item, Obsidian uses the [Lucide ↗](https://lucide.dev/)
 icon library, which lists available icons (and their names) on their website.

If your icon name isn't working, note that Obsidian may be a version or two behind what's listed there; if in doubt, check [Fevol's Icon Search tool ↗](https://fevol.github.io/obsidian-notes/utils/icons/)
, or use Note Toolbar's interface to add an item for a list of all icon names.

### Copy output

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#copy-output)

Add `--copy` to any command to copy the output to the clipboard.

```shell
obsidian note-toolbar:items empty format=csv --copy
```

* * *

General commands
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#general-commands)

### `note-toolbar`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbar)

Lists all toolbars or a toolbar's items.

```shell
toolbar=<nameOrId>  # Toolbar to list items for (name or ID)
format=csv|tsv      # Output format (default: tsv)
total               # Returns count
verbose             # Include additional details in output
```

### `note-toolbar:help`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarhelp)

Lists all Note Toolbar CLI actions.

### `note-toolbar:settings`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarsettings)

Opens settings UI in Obsidian for the provided item or toolbar. Opens main settings UI by default.

```shell
item=<itemId>       # ID of item to open settings for
toolbar=<nameOrId>  # Name or ID of toolbar to open settings for
```

Adding items
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#adding-items)

Add items to toolbars.

### `note-toolbar:add-break`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-break)

Adds a [break](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-toolbar-items#toolbar-layout)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-command`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-command)

Adds a [command item](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
command=<commandId>   # Obsidian command ID (e.g. editor:toggle-bold) (required)
focus                 # Focus the editor after executing the command (default: false)
target=split|tab      # Where to run command
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

#### Examples

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#examples-1)

```shell
# Add a bold toggle to an existing toolbar
note-toolbar:add-command to="Formatting Tools" icon=bold command="editor:toggle-bold"
```

### `note-toolbar:add-dv`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-dv)

Adds a [Dataview item](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Dataview)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
eval=<query>          # Dataview expression to evaluate (required: eval, query, or file/path)
query=<query>         # Dataview query to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)
file=<name>           # Filename to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)
path=<path>           # Filename with path to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)
args=<args>           # Comma-separated 'name: value' format, with string values in quotes
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

#### Examples

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#examples-2)

```shell
# List files in a folder
note-toolbar:add-dv to=Basic label=QueryExample query="LIST FROM \"Templates\" SORT file.name"

# Get the file modified time
note-toolbar:add-dv to=Basic label=EvalExample eval="this.file.mtime"
```

### `note-toolbar:add-file`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-file)

Adds a [file item](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/File-items)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>           # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>                  # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>                # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
file=<name>                    # File to link to (required: file or path)
path=<path>                    # Path of file to link to (required: file or path)
target=modal|split|tab|window  # Where to open the file
tooltip=<tooltip>              # Item tooltip
pos=<n>                        # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-group`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-group)

Adds an [item group](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-groups)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>       # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
toolbar=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar to add as a group (required)
pos=<n>                    # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-js`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-js)

Adds a [JavaScript item](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JavaScript)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
code=<code>           # JavaScript code to execute (required: code, file, or path)
file=<name>           # Filename to execute (required: code, file, or path)
path=<path>           # Filename with path to execute (required: code, file, or path)
args=<args>           # Comma-separated 'name: value' format, with string values in quotes
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-menu`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-menu)

Adds an [item menu](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Menus)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>       # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>              # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>            # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
toolbar=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar to add as a menu (required)
tooltip=<tooltip>          # Item tooltip
pos=<n>                    # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-sep`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-sep)

Adds a [separator](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-toolbar-items#toolbar-layout)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-spread`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-spread)

Adds a [spreader](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-toolbar-items#toolbar-layout)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-uri`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-uri)

Adds a [URI item](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/URI-items)
 to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>           # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>                  # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>                # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
uri=<link>                     # Website, URI, or note title (required)
target=modal|split|tab|window  # Where to open the URI
tooltip=<tooltip>              # Item tooltip
pos=<n>                        # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

Adding Templater items
----------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#adding-templater-items)

Add [Templater items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater)
 to toolbars.

### `note-toolbar:add-tp:command`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-tpcommand)

Adds an item to a toolbar that executes a Templater command.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
command=<name>        # Templater command to execute (required)
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-tp:create`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-tpcreate)

Adds an item to a toolbar that creates a note from a Templater template.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
file=<name>           # Template filename to create note from (required: file, or path)
path=<path>           # Template filename with path to create note from (required: file, or path)
output=<path>         # Folder and filename (without file extension) to output to
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-tp:exec`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-tpexec)

Adds an item to a toolbar that executes a Templater file.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
file=<name>           # Template filename to execute (required: file, or path)
path=<path>           # Template filename with path to execute (required: file, or path)
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:add-tp:insert`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaradd-tpinsert)

Adds an item to a toolbar that inserts a template.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
label=<label>         # Item label (required: label or icon)
icon=<iconName>       # Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)
file=<name>           # Template filename to insert (required: file, or path)
path=<path>           # Template filename with path to insert (required: file, or path)
tooltip=<tooltip>     # Item tooltip
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

Copying + Moving items
----------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#copying--moving-items)

Copy and move items to toolbars.

### `note-toolbar:copy`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarcopy)

Copies one or more items to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>         # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
item=<itemId>[,<itemId>...]  # Item ID, or comma-separated list of item IDs (required)
item=<itemId>[,<itemId>...]  # Item ID, or comma-separated list of item IDs (required)
pos=<n>                      # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

### `note-toolbar:move`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarmove)

Moves an item to a toolbar.

```shell
to=<toolbarNameOrId>  # Toolbar name or ID to add item to (required)
item=<itemId>         # Item ID (required)
pos=<n>               # Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)
```

Listing items
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#listing-items)

### `note-toolbar:gallery`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbargallery)

Lists items available in the [Note Toolbar Gallery](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
. Copy them to toolbars using the `note-toolbar:copy` command.

### `note-toolbar:items`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaritems)

Lists items in all toolbars, except empty items (no label or tooltip) by default.

```shell
toolbar=<nameOrId>  # Toolbar to list items for
filter=<string>     # Filter by string in label/tooltip
empty               # Include empty items in output
format=csv|tsv      # Output format (default: tsv)
total               # Returns count
verbose             # Include additional details in output
```

Using items
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#using-items)

### `note-toolbar:use`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbaruse)

Uses an item. Defaults to using the item within the active file.

```shell
item=<itemId>  # ID of item to use (required)
file=<name>    # File to use the item in
path=<path>    # Path of file to use the item in
```

Rules
-----

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#rules)

List toolbar display rules.

### `note-toolbar:rules`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarrules)

Lists toolbar [display rules](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Defining-where-to-show-toolbars)
.

```shell
format=csv|tsv  # Output format (default: tsv)
```

### `note-toolbar:status`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarstatus)

Lists toolbars that are visible (positioned) in the current view.

```shell
format=csv|tsv  # Output format (default: tsv)
```

Create toolbars
---------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#create-toolbars)

### `note-toolbar:import`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarimport)

> Available in `1.33.28`

Adds items, or creates a toolbar from a [Note Toolbar Callout](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-Callouts)
. Newlines should be escaped (`\\n`).

```shell
toolbar=<name>      # Toolbar name to add items to
callout=<markdown>  # Callout markdown (required: callout, file, or path)
file=<name>         # Filename of callout (required: callout, file, or path)
path=<path>         # Filename with path of callout (required: callout, file, or path)
```

#### Examples

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#examples-3)

```shell
note-toolbar:import toolbar="Daily Notes" callout='> [!note-toolbar]\\n> - [:LiArrowLeft:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes:goto-prev"/> <!-- Previous day -->\\n> - [:LiCalendar:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes"/> <!-- Today -->\\n> - [:LiArrowRight:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes:goto-next"/> <!-- Next day -->'
```

### `note-toolbar:new`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-CLI#note-toolbarnew)

Creates a new toolbar.

```shell
name=<name>         # Toolbar name
desc=<description>  # Toolbar description (1.34)
icon=<iconName>     # Toolbar icon, from Lucide's icon set (1.34)
```

Note Toolbar API
================

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Aug 17, 2026 · [160 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API/_history)

The Note Toolbar API can be [executed from Note Toolbar items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts)
 to get toolbar access, and to show UI (suggesters, prompts, menus, and modals). The latter enables Dataview JS, JS Engine, or Templater scripts to ask for information, or to show helpful text.

_I would appreciate your feedback, which you can leave in [the discussions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions)
._

Getting started
---------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getting-started)

Even if you're not a developer, getting started with the API is easy:

1.  Create a new toolbar item with a **JavaScript type**.
2.  **Select function... → Evaluate JavaScript**.
3.  Copy/Paste one of the examples provided into the **JavaScript expression** field.

`ntb` API
---------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#ntb-api)

*   **[Note Manipulation](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#Note-manipulation)
    **
    *   [ntb.getProperty](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getproperty)
        
    *   [ntb.setProperty](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#setproperty)
        
    *   [ntb.getSelection](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getselection)
        
    *   [ntb.setSelection](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#setselection)
        
*   **[Toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#Toolbars)
    **
    *   [ntb.export](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#export)
        
    *   [ntb.getActiveItem](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getactiveitem)
        
    *   [ntb.getItem](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getitem)
        
    *   [ntb.getToolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#gettoolbars)

* * *

Warning

You can also directly access Note Toolbar's settings or toolbar items via `app.plugins.getPlugin("note-toolbar").settings`, but be aware that these are subject to change and may break your scripts. The API will be the official way to access and change information about toolbars.

* * *

Note Manipulation
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#note-manipulation)

Functions for reading and manipulating notes in the vault.

### getProperty

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getproperty)

> **getProperty**: (`property`) => `string` | `undefined`

Gets the value of the given property in the active note.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `property` | `string` | The property to get the frontmatter for. |

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns)

`string` | `undefined`

The frontmatter value for the given property, or `undefined` if it does not exist.

#### Example

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example)

```ts
const createdDate = ntb.getProperty('created');
```

* * *

### getSelection

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getselection)

> **getSelection**: () => `string`

Gets the currently selected text, or the word at the current cursor position, if nothing's selected. Only works in markdown editing or reading modes.

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-1)

`string`

The selected text, or the word at the current cursor position. Otherwise returns an empty string.

#### Since

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since)

1.26

* * *

### setProperty

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#setproperty)

> **setProperty**: (`property`, `value`) => `Promise`<`void`\>

Sets the given property's value in the active note. Set the property to `null` to remove it.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-1)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `property` | `string` | Propety to set in the frontmatter. |
| `value` | `unknown` | Value to set for the property. |

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-2)

`Promise`<`void`\>

#### Example

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-1)

```ts
await ntb.setProperty('Created', moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
await ntb.setProperty('cssclasses', 'myclass');
await ntb.setProperty('A Link', '[[Some Note]]');
await ntb.setProperty('A Number', 1234);
await ntb.setProperty('A List', ['asdf', 'asdf2']);
await ntb.setProperty('Delete Me', null);
```

* * *

### setSelection

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#setselection)

> **setSelection**: (`replacement`) => `void`

Replaces the selection, the word at the cursor, or inserts at the cursor if neither exists.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-2)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `replacement` | `string` | The text to replace the selection with. |

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-3)

`void`

#### Remarks

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#remarks)

This does not do anything in Reading mode.

#### Example

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-2)

```ts
// makes the selected text or the current word red
ntb.setSelection(`<span style="color: var(--color-red)">${ntb.getSelection()}</span>`);
```

#### Since

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since-1)

1.26

Toolbars
--------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#toolbars)

Methods for creating and updating toolbars.

### export

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#export)

> **export**: (`toolbar`) => `Promise`<`string` | `null`\>

Exports the given toolbar as a [Note Toolbar callout](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-Callouts)
.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-3)

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `toolbar` | [`IToolbar`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/IToolbar.Interface.IToolbar.md) |

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-4)

`Promise`<`string` | `null`\>

Toolbar as a callout or `null` if the toolbar is undefined.

#### Example

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-3)

```ts
const toolbars = ntb.getToolbars();
for (let toolbar of toolbars) {
    console.log(`\n## ${toolbar.getName()}\n\n`);
    console.log(await ntb.export(toolbar));
}
```

#### See

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#see)

`NtbExport.js` in the [examples/Scripts folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts)
.

#### Since

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since-2)

1.29

* * *

### getActiveItem

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getactiveitem)

> **getActiveItem**: () => [`IItem`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/IItem.Interface.IItem.md)
>  | `undefined`

Gets the active (last activated) toolbar item.

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-5)

[`IItem`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/IItem.Interface.IItem.md)
 | `undefined`

The active (last activated) item.

#### Remarks

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#remarks-1)

This does not work with Note Toolbar Callouts.

* * *

### getItem

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#getitem)

> **getItem**: (`id`) => [`IItem`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/IItem.Interface.IItem.md)
>  | `undefined`

Gets an item by its [ID](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs)
, if it exists.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-4)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The [ID](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs)<br> of the item. |

#### Returns

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-6)

[`IItem`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/IItem.Interface.IItem.md)
 | `undefined`

The item, or undefined.

#### Example

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-4)

```js
// to get the ID, edit an item's settings and use _Copy developer ID_
const item = ntb.getItem('112c7ed3-d5c2-4750-b95d-75bc84e23513');
```

UI Components
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#ui-components)

Functions for showing various UI components, such as menus, modals, toolbars, and suggesters.

### fileSuggester

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#filesuggester)

> **fileSuggester**: (`files`, `options?`) => `Promise`<`TAbstractFile` | `null`\>

Shows a file suggester modal for the provided files and waits for the user's selection. Files are sorted by recency.

#### Parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-5)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | `TAbstractFile`\[\] | \-  |
| `options?` | { `allowCustomInput?`: `boolean`; `class?`: `string`; `collapse?`: `boolean`; `default?`: `string`; `exact?`: `boolean`; `filesonly?`: `boolean`; `folder?`: `string`; `foldersonly?`: `boolean`; `icon?`: `string`; `keymap?`: `object`\[\]; `label?`: `string`; `limit?`: `number`; `placeholder?`: `string`; `prefixes?`: `Record`<`string`, `unknown`\[\] \| (() => `unknown`\[\] \| `Promise`<`unknown`\>)>; `rendermd?`: `boolean`; } | Optional display options. |
| `options.allowCustomInput?` | `boolean` | If set to `true`, the user can input a custom value that is not in the list of suggestions. Default is `false`. |
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |
| `options.collapse?` | `boolean` | If set to `true`, the results and suggester instructions are hidden until input is provided. Default is `false`. **Since** 1.29.14 |
| `options.default?` | `string` | Optionally pre-set the suggester's input with this value. Matching results will be shown, as if you typed in that string yourself (assuming the string appears in the list of options provided). If not provided, no default is set. |
| `options.exact?` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use substring matching instead of fuzzy matching, prioritizing results that start with the input string. Default is `false`. **Since** 1.30.10 |
| `options.filesonly?` | `boolean` | If set to true, only files are shown. If not provided, defaults to `false`. |
| `options.folder?` | `string` | Limit results to this folder. **Since** 1.30.14 |
| `options.foldersonly?` | `boolean` | If set to true, only folders are shown. If not provided, defaults to `false`. |
| `options.icon?` | `string` | Optional icon to place before the input field. **Since** 1.29.14 |
| `options.keymap?` | `object`\[\] | Optionally replace key bindings. **See** [NtbKeyBinding](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/INoteToolbarApi.Interface.NtbKeyBinding.md)<br> for available actions and modifier options. **Since** 1.30.06 |
| `options.label?` | `string` | Optional text shown above the input field, with markdown formatting supported. Default is no label. |
| `options.limit?` | `number` | Optional limit of the number of items rendered at once (useful to improve performance when displaying large lists). |
| `options.placeholder?` | `string` | Optional placeholder text for input field; defaults to preset message. |
| `options.prefixes?` | `Record`<`string`, `unknown`\[\] \| (() => `unknown`\[\] \| `Promise`<`unknown`\>)> | Maps input prefixes to arrays or functions that return suggestions, or a Promise (e.g. another suggester) that resolves to a value which is injected into the input. **Examples** `{ '#': ['tag1', 'tag2'], '[[': () => getFiles() }` `{ '#': async () => await ntb.suggester(lorem, ipsum) }` **Since** 1.30.0 |\
| `options.rendermd?` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to disable rendering of suggestions as markdown. Default is `true`. |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-8)\
\
`Promise`<`TAbstractFile` | `null`\>\
\
The selected [TAbstractFile](https://docs.obsidian.md/Reference/TypeScript+API/TAbstractFile)\
.\
\
#### Remarks\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#remarks-2)\
\
This function replaces the old fileSuggester(options?).\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples)\
\
```ts\
const fileOrFolder = await ntb.fileSuggester(\
  ntb.app.vault.getAllLoadedFiles()\
);\
if (fileOrFolder) new Notice(fileOrFolder.name);\
```\
\
```ts\
// show only folders\
const folder = await ntb.fileSuggester(\
  ntb.app.vault.getAllLoadedFiles(),\
  { foldersonly: true }\
);\
if (folder) new Notice(folder.name);\
```\
\
#### Since\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since-3)\
\
1.33.15\
\

\
### menu\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#menu)\
\
> **menu**: (`toolbarOrItems`, `options?`) => `Promise`<`void`\>\
\
Shows a menu with the provided items.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-6)\
\
| Parameter | Type | Description |\
| --- | --- | --- |\
| `toolbarOrItems` | `string` \| [`NtbMenuItem`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/INoteToolbarApi.Interface.NtbMenuItem.md)<br>\[\] | Toolbar name or [ID](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs)<br>; or an array of items to display. See [NtbMenuItem](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/INoteToolbarApi.Interface.NtbMenuItem.md)<br>. |\
| `options?` | { `class?`: `string`; `focusInMenu?`: `boolean`; `id?`: `string`; `position`: `"cursor"` \| `"pointer"` \| `"toolbar"`; } | Optional display options. |\
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |\
| `options.focusInMenu?` | `boolean` | If `true`, the menu item will be focused when the menu opens; defaults to `false`. |\
| `options.id?` | `string` | Optional ID to add to the menu when it's rendered. **Since** 1.27 |\
| `options.position?` | `"cursor"` \| `"pointer"` \| `"toolbar"` | Sets the position in which the menu will appear; defaults to `toolbar`. `cursor`: editor cursor or selected text position (falls back to pointer position, e.g., if editor is not in focus); `pointer`: mouse/pointer position; `toolbar`: last clicked toolbar element position (falls back to pointer position) **Since** 1.27 |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-9)\
\
`Promise`<`void`\>\
\
Nothing. Displays the menu.\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples-1)\
\
```ts\
// show the "Daily Notes" toolbar as a menu\
await ntb.menu('Daily Notes');\
```\
\
```ts\
// create a menu from scratch\
await ntb.menu([\
  { type: 'command', value: 'editor:toggle-bold', label: 'Toggle Bold', icon: 'bold' },\
  { type: 'file', value: 'Home.md', label: 'Open File' },\
  { type: 'uri', value: 'https://example.com', label: 'Visit Site' }\
]);\
```\
\
```ts\
// shows bookmarks in a menu\
const b = ntb.app.internalPlugins.plugins['bookmarks'];\
if (!b?.enabled) return;\
const i = b.instance?.getBookmarks();\
const mi = i\
  .filter(b => b.type === 'file' || b.type === 'folder')\
  .map(b => ({\
      type: 'file',\
      value: b.path,\
      label: b.title ? b.title : b.path,\
      icon: b.type === 'folder' ? 'folder' : 'file'\
  }));\
ntb.menu(mi);\
```\
\
* * *\
\
### modal\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#modal)\
\
> **modal**: (`content`, `options?`) => `Promise`<`Modal`\>\
\
Shows a modal with the provided content.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-7)\
\
| Parameter | Type | Description |\
| --- | --- | --- |\
| `content` | `string` \| `TFile` | Content to display in the modal, either as a string or a file within the vault. |\
| `options?` | { `class?`: `string`; `contextPath?`: `string`; `originAsContext?`: `boolean`; `title?`: `string`; `webpage?`: `boolean`; } | Optional display options. |\
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |\
| `options.contextPath?` | `string` | Optionally specify which file rendered content should use as context. For example, Bases queries that use `this.file` will refer to this file. |\
| `options.originAsContext?` | `boolean` | Use the file that opened the modal as context (assumes the active file); defaults to `false`. Ignored when `contextPath` is provided. |\
| `options.title?` | `string` | Optional title for the modal, with markdown formatting supported. |\
| `options.webpage?` | `boolean` | If `true`, the modal will show the web page URL in `content` using the Web Viewer core plugin (if enabled); defaults to `false`. |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-10)\
\
`Promise`<`Modal`\>\
\
A `Modal`, in case you want to manipulate it further; can be ignored otherwise.\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples-2)\
\
```ts\
// shows a modal with the provided string\
await ntb.modal("_Hello_ world!");\
```\
\
```ts\
// shows a modal with the rendered contents of a file\
const filename = "Welcome.md";\
const file = ntb.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(filename);\
\
if (file) {\
  await ntb.modal(file, {\
    title: `**${file.basename}**`\
  });\
}\
else {\
  new Notice(`File not found: ${filename}`);\
}\
```\
\
```ts\
// renders a Base for the current file\
const fn = "Bases/Backlinks.base";\
const f = ntb.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(fn);\
if (f) { \
  await ntb.modal(f, {\
    originAsContext: true,\
    // ...or remove the above line and render for a completely different file:\
    //contextPath: "Other File.md"  \
  });\
}\
```\
\
#### See\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#see-1)\
\
`NtbModal.js` in the [examples/Scripts folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts)\
.\
\

### prompt\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#prompt)\
\
> **prompt**: (`options?`) => `Promise`<`string` | `null`\>\
\
Shows the prompt modal and waits for the user's input.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-8)\
\
| Parameter | Type | Description |\
| --- | --- | --- |\
| `options?` | { `class?`: `string`; `default?`: `string`; `label?`: `string`; `large?`: `boolean`; `placeholder?`: `string`; } | Optional display options. |\
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |\
| `options.default?` | `string` | Optional default value for text field. If not provided, no default value is set. |\
| `options.label?` | `string` | Optional text shown above the text field, with markdown formatting supported. Default is no label. |\
| `options.large?` | `boolean` | If set to `true`, the input field will be multi line. If not provided, defaults to `false`. |\
| `options.placeholder?` | `string` | Optional text inside text field. Defaults to a preset message. |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-11)\
\
`Promise`<`string` | `null`\>\
\
The user's input.\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples-3)\
\
```ts\
// default (one-line) prompt with default placeholder message\
const result = await ntb.prompt();\
\
new Notice(result);\
```\
\
```ts\
// large prompt with message, overridden placeholder, and default value \
const result = await ntb.prompt({\
  label: "Enter some text",\
  large: true,\
  placeholder: "Placeholder",\
  default: "Default"\
});\
\
new Notice(result);\
```\
\
#### See\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#see-2)\
\
`NtbPrompt.js` in the [examples/Scripts folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts)\
.\
\
