### suggester\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#suggester)\
\
> **suggester**: (`values?`, `keys?`, `options?`) => `Promise`<`T` | `null`\>\
\
Shows a suggester modal and waits for the user's selection.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-9)\
\
| Parameter | Type | Description |\
| --- | --- | --- |\
| `values?` | `string`\[\] \| ((`value`) => `string`) | Array of strings representing the text that will be displayed for each item in the suggester prompt. This can also be a function that maps an item to its text representation. Markdown formatting is supported: optionally mix in Obsidian and plugin markdown (e.g., Iconize) to have it rendered |\
| `keys?` | `T`\[\] | Optional array containing the keys of each item in the correct order. If not provided or `null`, values are returned on selection. |\
| `options?` | { `allowCustomInput?`: `boolean`; `class?`: `string`; `collapse?`: `boolean`; `default?`: `string`; `exact?`: `boolean`; `icon?`: `string`; `keymap?`: `object`\[\]; `label?`: `string`; `limit?`: `number`; `placeholder?`: `string`; `prefixes?`: `Record`<`string`, `unknown`\[\] \| (() => `unknown`\[\] \| `Promise`<`unknown`\>)>; `rendermd?`: `boolean`; } | Optional display options. |\
| `options.allowCustomInput?` | `boolean` | If set to `true`, the user can input a custom value that is not in the list of suggestions. Default is `false`. |\
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |\
| `options.collapse?` | `boolean` | If set to `true`, the results and suggester instructions are hidden until input is provided. Default is `false`. **Since** 1.29.14 |\
| `options.default?` | `string` | Optionally pre-set the suggester's input with this value. Matching results will be shown, as if you typed in that string yourself (assuming the string appears in the list of options provided). If not provided, no default is set. |\
| `options.exact?` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use substring matching instead of fuzzy matching, prioritizing results that start with the input string. Default is `false`. **Since** 1.30.10 |\
| `options.icon?` | `string` | Optional icon to place before the input field. **Since** 1.29.14 |\
| `options.keymap?` | `object`\[\] | Optionally replace key bindings. **See** [NtbKeyBinding](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/INoteToolbarApi.Interface.NtbKeyBinding.md)<br> for available actions and modifier options. **Since** 1.30.06 |\
| `options.label?` | `string` | Optional text shown above the input field, with markdown formatting supported. Default is no label. |\
| `options.limit?` | `number` | Optional limit of the number of items rendered at once (useful to improve performance when displaying large lists). |\
| `options.placeholder?` | `string` | Optional placeholder text for input field; defaults to preset message. |\
| `options.prefixes?` | `Record`<`string`, `unknown`\[\] \| (() => `unknown`\[\] \| `Promise`<`unknown`\>)> | Maps input prefixes to arrays or functions that return suggestions, or a Promise (e.g. another suggester) that resolves to a value which is injected into the input. **Examples** `{ '#': ['tag1', 'tag2'], '[[': () => getFiles() }` `{ '#': async () => await ntb.suggester(lorem, ipsum) }` **Since** 1.30.0 |\
| `options.rendermd?` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to disable rendering of suggestions as markdown. Default is `true`. |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-12)\
\
`Promise`<`T` | `null`\>\
\
The selected value, or corresponding key if keys are provided.\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples-4)\
\
```ts\
// shows a suggester that returns the selected value \
const values = ["value `1`", "value `2`"];\
const selectedValue = await ntb.suggester(values);\
new Notice(selectedValue);\
```\
\
```ts\
// shows a suggester that returns a key corresponding to the selected value, and overrides placeholder text\
const values = ["value `1`", "value `2`"];\
const keys = ["key1", "key2"];\
const selectedKey = await ntb.suggester(values, keys, {\
  placeholder: "Pick something"\
});\
new Notice(selectedKey);\
```\
\
```ts\
// shows a suggester with no existing values that can be typed in; displays tag and file suggestions when those prefixes are entered\
const selected = await ntb.suggester(null, null, {\
  prefixes: {\
    "#": () => ntb.getTags(),\
    "[[": () => this.ntb.app.vault.getAllLoadedFiles().map(f => `[[${f.extension === 'md' ? f.basename : f.name}]]`)\
  }\
});\
new Notice(selected);\
```\
\
```ts\
// displays a suggester with the key mappings overridden\
const values = ['cat', 'dog'];\
const selected = await ntb.suggester(values, null, {\
    keymap: [\
        { key: 'Tab', action: 'navigateNext' },\
        { modifiers: ['Ctrl'], key: 'Tab', action: 'select' },\
        { key: 'ArrowRight', action: 'autofill' },\
    ],\
});\
new Notice(selected);\
```\
\
#### See\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#see-3)\
\
`NtbSuggester.js` in the [examples/Scripts folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts)\
.\
\

### toolbar\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#toolbar)\
\
> **toolbar**: (`toolbarNameOrId`, `options?`) => `Promise`<`void`\>\
\
Shows a (floating) toolbar. Defaults to the 'toolbar' position.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-10)\
\
| Parameter | Type | Description |\
| --- | --- | --- |\
| `toolbarNameOrId` | `string` | Toolbar name or [ID](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs)<br>. |\
| `options?` | { `class?`: `string`; `position`: `"cursor"` \| `"pointer"` \| `"toolbar"`; } | Optional display options. |\
| `options.class?` | `string` | Optional CSS class(es) to add to the component. |\
| `options.position?` | `"cursor"` \| `"pointer"` \| `"toolbar"` | Sets the position in which the toolbar will appear; defaults to `toolbar`. `cursor`: editor cursor or selected text position (falls back to pointer position, e.g., if editor is not in focus); `pointer`: mouse/pointer position; `toolbar`: last clicked toolbar element position (falls back to pointer position) |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-13)\
\
`Promise`<`void`\>\
\
Nothing. Displays the toolbar.\
\
#### Examples\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#examples-5)\
\
```ts\
// show the "Daily Notes" toolbar at the toolbar button (default)\
ntb.toolbar('Daily Notes');\
```\
\
```ts\
// show the "Daily Notes" toolbar at the cursor position (or above the text selection)\
ntb.toolbar('Daily Notes', { position: 'cursor' });\
```\
\

\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since-4)\
\
1.27\

### o\

> **o**: `__module`\
\
Reference to the [Obsidian API module](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-api/blob/master/obsidian.d.ts)\
 for accessing Obsidian classes and utilities from scripts.\
\
#### Example\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-6)\
\
```ts\
// get the current markdown view\
const view = ntb.app.workspace.getActiveViewOfType(ntb.o.MarkdownView);\
```\
\
#### Since\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#since-7)\
\
1.26\
\
* * *\
\
### t\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#t)\
\
> **t**: (`key`, ...`args`) => `string`\
\
This is the [i18next translation function](https://www.i18next.com/translation-function/essentials)\
, scoped to Note Toolbar's localized strings.\
\
#### Parameters\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#parameters-11)\
\
| Parameter | Type |\
| --- | --- |\
| `key` | `string` |\
| ...`args` | `unknown`\[\] |\
\
#### Returns\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#returns-16)\
\
`string`\
\
The string translation corresponding with the provided key, if it exists, with a fallback to English. If the key does not exist, the key is returned.\
\
#### Example\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#example-7)\
\
```ts\
// shows "Copied to clipboard" if the language is English, or in another langauge if the translation exists\
new Notice(ntb.t('api.msg.clipboard-copied'));\
```\
\
#### See\
\
[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#see-4)\
\
*   For usage, see the [i18next documentation](https://www.i18next.com/translation-function/essentials)\
    .\
*   `en.json` and other translations in the [src/I18n folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/src/I18n)\
    .\

Examples
========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Sep 17, 2026 · [135 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples/_history)

Important

As of version `1.21`, Note Toolbar includes a [built-in Gallery](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
 which features 130+ items that can be added in one click/tap.

Below is an archive of the old Examples and ideas that could be added/imported in batch. [The Gallery](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
 features all of these, and more. [Give it a try!](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)

* * *

Here are some ideas on how to use Note Toolbar.

Review the markdown at the bottom of each example to see what each icon does. All use built-in commands, unless otherwise mentioned.

These are just ideas. Mix and match these to create a toolbar that's uniquely yours. [Share your own examples](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
 or see what the community has contributed, and help me make this even better.

For example scripts, check out the [examples folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples)
.

Tip

With Note Toolbar v1.14 or later, you can use the buttons below to easily add each toolbar directly to Obsidian. Alternately, copy the markdown shown, then add it as a new or existing toolbar, using the import button ![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/375951347-05de8c9f-04ff-4ef3-b91d-5aa0e88213ce.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..SosNHSkONPc9pxFA4HJ1UP9iQ8JFiTk63UW5aSr0_GA) in Note Toolbar's Settings.

Daily Notes
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#daily-notes)

Quickly navigate between daily notes.

🧩 Requires the core Daily Notes plugin. You could also use the [Periodic Notes](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=periodic-notes)
 plugin to link to weekly and monthly notes.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 41 43](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376391925-33668663-6e3e-44cd-b462-6f3f7b73d110.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ncrk8fU51TG2Z6E0-zuO9lO6RCuME5cLfitLGAWZpME)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Daily%20Notes%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiArrowLeft%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22daily-notes%3Agoto-prev%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Previous%20daily%20note%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiCalendarCheck%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22daily-notes%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Today%27s%20daily%20note%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiArrowRight%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22daily-notes%3Agoto-next%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Next%20daily%20note%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Daily Notes
> - [:LiArrowLeft:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes:goto-prev"/> <!-- Previous daily note -->
> - [:LiCalendarCheck:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes"/> <!-- Today's daily note -->
> - [:LiArrowRight:]()<data data-ntb-command="daily-notes:goto-next"/> <!-- Next daily note -->
```

Formatting
----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#formatting)

Add a bunch of note formatting commands.

🧩 Some items require [Dataview ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=dataview)
, [Templater ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=templater-obsidian)
, [JS Engine ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=js-engine)
, and scripts from the [examples folder](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts)
.

Items that give you quick access to Obsidian's help documentation, Markdown reference, other resources, and settings.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 40 33](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376391777-5dba051d-341f-4971-a947-0178441b464b.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..NaT22rzEbkHkPHoo1_k239QQSrF5zIU3asShmhTKjPQ)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Obsidian%20Help%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiBook%3A%5D(%3Chttps%3A%2F%2Fhelp.obsidian.md%2F%3E)%20%3C!--%20Obsidian%20help%20site%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiBookDown%3A%5D(%3Chttps%3A%2F%2Fhelp.obsidian.md%2FEditing%2Band%2Bformatting%2FBasic%2Bformatting%2Bsyntax%3E)%20%3C!--%20Markdown%20reference%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiMessageCircle%3A%5D(%3Chttps%3A%2F%2Fforum.obsidian.md%2F%3E)%20%3C!--%20Obsidian%20forum%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiMessagesSquare%3A%5D(%3Chttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.reddit.com%2Fr%2FObsidianMD%2F%3E)%20%3C!--%20Obsidian%20subreddit%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiDiscord%3A%5D(%3Chttps%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fobsidianmd%3E)%20%3C!--%20Obsidian%20Discord%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiSettings%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22app%3Aopen-settings%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Open%20settings%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Obsidian Help
> - [:LiBook:](https://help.obsidian.md/) <!-- Obsidian help site -->
> - [:LiBookDown:](https://help.obsidian.md/Editing+and+formatting/Basic+formatting+syntax) <!-- Markdown reference -->
> - [:LiMessageCircle:](https://forum.obsidian.md/) <!-- Obsidian forum -->
> - [:LiMessagesSquare:](https://www.reddit.com/r/ObsidianMD/) <!-- Obsidian subreddit -->
> - [:LiDiscord:](https://discord.gg/obsidianmd) <!-- Obsidian Discord -->
> - [:LiSettings:]()<data data-ntb-command="app:open-settings"/> <!-- Open settings -->
```

Obsidian Sync
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#obsidian-sync)

If you're an Obsidian Sync user, see the change history of your current note.

🧩 Requires the [Obsidian Sync ↗](https://obsidian.md/sync)
 service.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 46 01](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376392710-a1801a43-cad7-4ced-82e5-e9290581c30e.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..LJpCiilCCLSpOQIS9Ssz_NqwB_fMUZLmx9ZynK5t24o)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Obsidian%20Sync%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiFileClock%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22sync%3Aview-version-history%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Version%20history%20for%20current%20file%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Obsidian Sync
> - [:LiFileClock:]()<data data-ntb-command="sync:view-version-history"/> <!-- Version history for current file -->
```

Search
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#search)

Search across all files or the current file. Open the bookmarks panel.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 46 51](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376392821-69b0b402-0f62-40fd-bb9f-7c85f03bdfb9.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..w2x2-hnaGKBjt84Q3Ud9W0UGokD0UdwdFlJD1VK6N-c)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Search%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiFileSearch%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22editor%3Aopen-search-replace%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Search%20%26%20replace%20in%20current%20file%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiSearch%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22global-search%3Aopen%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Search%20in%20all%20files%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiBookmark%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22bookmarks%3Aopen%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Show%20bookmarks%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Search
> - [:LiFileSearch:]()<data data-ntb-command="editor:open-search-replace"/> <!-- Search & replace in current file -->
> - [:LiSearch:]()<data data-ntb-command="global-search:open"/> <!-- Search in all files -->
> - [:LiBookmark:]()<data data-ntb-command="bookmarks:open"/> <!-- Show bookmarks -->
```

Switch themes and views
-----------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#switch-themes-and-views)

Move between different themes and modes.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 47 18](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376392898-ed3a72a1-adc2-4940-853f-3615ef7b2fbc.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..NPWzpz6hLgzQgxlQA8BfWG5GomDT8DW7A2wLmJhq20o)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Theme%20Tools%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiSun%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22theme%3Ause-light%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Use%20light%20mode%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiMoon%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22theme%3Ause-dark%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Use%20dark%20mode%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiVenetianMask%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22theme%3Aswitch%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Change%20theme%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiBookOpen%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22markdown%3Atoggle-preview%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Toggle%20reading%20view%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiCode2%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22editor%3Atoggle-source%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Toggle%20Live%20Preview%2FSource%20mode%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Theme Tools
> - [:LiSun:]()<data data-ntb-command="theme:use-light"/> <!-- Use light mode -->
> - [:LiMoon:]()<data data-ntb-command="theme:use-dark"/> <!-- Use dark mode -->
> - [:LiVenetianMask:]()<data data-ntb-command="theme:switch"/> <!-- Change theme -->
> - [:LiBookOpen:]()<data data-ntb-command="markdown:toggle-preview"/> <!-- Toggle reading view -->
> - [:LiCode2:]()<data data-ntb-command="editor:toggle-source"/> <!-- Toggle Live Preview/Source mode -->
```

Templater
---------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#templater)

Insert and create new notes from templates.

Use the [Templater item type](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater)
, or bind your template to a hotkey in Templater's settings to expose a command you can use from Note Toolbar.

🧩 Requires the [Templater ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=templater-obsidian)
 plugin.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 47 47](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376392968-69cd3af6-84e8-43b3-af8c-2efd364fb6cb.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..R0UIR8VyJ6tiuLOTqUJHDfXCXgZF3WAb2jCAE-Yr5aw)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Templater%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiTemplaterIcon%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22templater-obsidian%3Ainsert-templater%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Insert%20template%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiPercentSquare%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22templater-obsidian%3Acreate-new-note-from-template%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20New%20note%20from%20template%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Templater
> - [:LiTemplaterIcon:]()<data data-ntb-command="templater-obsidian:insert-templater"/> <!-- Insert template -->
> - [:LiPercentSquare:]()<data data-ntb-command="templater-obsidian:create-new-note-from-template"/> <!-- New note from template -->
```

Vault navigation
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#vault-navigation)

Get around your vault quickly: Use [variables](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Variables)
 to use a property (`Up` in this case) to move to a related note. Add a shortcut back to your _Home_ note or dashboard. Consider adding the `Navigate back` and `Navigate forward` commands for convenient access, or the `Go to... tab` commands for quicker access on mobile.

![CleanShot 2024-10-14 at 17 48 12](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/376393021-37f33231-3d9c-473f-84bd-a71ad9fec9d7.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..UJ0xZ4zo8T_fVCRtvQE-GCrcHWMS5FDr8N7jF3u9p94)

[![](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/28fd64761d0b4a574613d2aa1d78a2fbf70312862b0acfd6f4e14d4e93b8889d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f41646425323074686973253230746f6f6c6261722d3841354346353f7374796c653d706c6173746963253041 "Add this toolbar to Obsidian")](https://chrisgurney.github.io/obsidian-note-toolbar/open.htm?uri=obsidian%3A%2F%2Fnote-toolbar%3Fimport%3D%3E%20%5B!note-toolbar%5D%20Vault%20Navigation%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiArrowUpLeft%3A%20%7B%7Bprop_up%7D%7D%5D(%3C%7B%7Bprop_up%7D%7D%3E)%20%3C!--%20Go%20up%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%5BHome.md%7C%3ALiHome%3A%5D%5D%20%3C!--%20Home%20--%3E%0A%3E%20-%20%5B%3ALiBookmark%3A%5D()%3Cdata%20data-ntb-command%3D%22bookmarks%3Aopen%22%2F%3E%20%3C!--%20Show%20bookmarks%20--%3E%0A)

View callout markdown

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Vault Navigation
> - [:LiArrowUpLeft: {{prop_up}}]({{prop_up}}) <!-- Go up -->
> - [[Home|:LiHome:]] <!-- Home -->
> - [:LiBookmark:]()<data data-ntb-command="bookmarks:open"/> <!-- Show bookmarks -->
```

More about [Navigation](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation)
.

More ideas
----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#more-ideas)

*   Show your [actual bookmarks](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Bookmarks)
     in a toolbar with Dataview
*   Execute [Shell Commands](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Shell-Commands)
     with the Shell Commands plugin
*   Launch Apple Shortcuts (via [Shortcut Launcher](https://github.com/macstories/obsidian-shortcut-launcher)
    ) • [Related reading ↗](https://heydingus.net/blog/2022/2/shortcuts-tips-contextualize-your-tasks-with-shortcuts-run-from-urls/)
    
*   Start Pomodoro timer (via `Status Bar Pomodoro Timer: Start pomodoro` command from [Status Bar Pomo Timer](https://github.com/kzhovn/statusbar-pomo-obsidian)
    )

See the [Show and Tell](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
 discussion for examples of toolbars in practice... and help add to it!

Need help? 🛟
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Examples#need-help-)

If you're having an issue with a particular plugin, please refer to their help documentation.

Otherwise, [ask a question](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions)
 or [request a feature](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/discussions/categories/ideas)
! If you run into something that looks like a bug, please [log an issue](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/issues)
.

File types
==========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/File-types#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Aug 18, 2026 · [22 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/File-types/_history)

Under the **File types** settings, toggle whether toolbars appear in bases, canvases, PDFs, video, and in other common file types.

*   Which toolbar appears in these file types depend on its [Display rules](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Defining-where-to-show-toolbars)
    , as they do with notes.
*   Toolbars appear based on their **Position** setting, with the exception of the `Below Properties` position, in which case the toolbar appears in the `Top (fixed)` position instead.

Other data types
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/File-types#other-data-types)

In the **Other data types** setting, you can manually list out other file types not shown above, if you can figure out their _data type_ (e.g., `excalidraw`). Here are some hints on how to figure out what to enter here:

*   This uses the **data type**, which can be found by:
    1.  inspecting the editor with the developer console when you have a file open, and
    2.  searching for the `data-type` attribute.
*   This is _not_ the same as the file's extension (e.g., Excalidraw files actually have a `.md` file extension).

| For this plugin/view... | ...enter this data type |
| --- | --- |
| Excalidraw | `excalidraw` |
| Graph view | `graph`  <br>(Uses the _New tab view_ toolbar, if one is configured.) |

_Let me know if you need help trying to figure this out for a given plugin or file type._

Command items
=============

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jun 9, 2026 · [34 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items/_history)

**Command** items execute commands built into Obsidian, or commands provided by plugins.

After selecting the **Commmand** item type, search for the command that will be executed when the toolbar item is clicked/tapped.

Tip

Can't find a command that does what you want? Explore the [Gallery](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Gallery)
 or learn about [Executing scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts)
.

Advanced settings
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items#advanced-settings)

Clicking on the gear (⚙️) icon opens advanced options:

### Disable if not available

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items#disable-if-not-available)

Disables this item in the toolbar, if its command cannot be performed in the current context (e.g., if enabled, an item using the _Bold_ command is disabled in Reading mode). This setting is disabled by default.

Note

Not all commands offer this check (i.e., the _Disable if not available_ setting won't do anything). The easiest way to check if Note Toolbar should be disabling a command is to see if it is available in the command palette when you're in a different context (e.g., in Reading mode vs. Editing mode).

Note

Under the covers, Note Toolbar is calling [`editorCallback()` and `checkCallback()`](https://docs.obsidian.md/Plugins/User+interface/Commands#Conditional+commands)
 to confirm command availability.

### Focus in editor

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items#focus-in-editor)

Sets the focus in the editor after running the command.

*   On mobile, if enabled, this keeps the keyboard visible.
*   This can be useful for formatting commands, such as _Toggle bold_, _Toggle italics_, etc.
*   Note Toolbar is unable to wait until the command is fully completed.

### Where to run command

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Command-items#where-to-run-command)

Specify where the command should be executed: Default (current tab), in a _New tab_, or in a _Split pane_.

*   This can be useful for commands such as creating a _Kanban: Create new board_, so that the board is created in a new tab instead of the current one.
*   Some commands may override this setting as they do their own thing.

Item Groups
===========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Groups#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Apr 10, 2026 · [7 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Groups/_history)

An **Item Group** allows you to directly embed a toolbar within another toolbar.

After selecting the **Item Group** type, select the toolbar you want to embed.

How it works
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Groups#how-it-works)

*   Say Toolbar 1 has these items: `A` `B` `C`
*   Toolbar 2 has these items: `D` `E`
*   Add an Item Group type item to the end of Toolbar 2 that's just a reference to Toolbar 1's items: Now Toolbar 2 has these items: `D` `E` `A` `B` `C`

Notes
-----

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Groups#notes)

*   The position and styling of the "parent" toolbar is maintained. e.g., Toolbar 2 will continue to be styled and positioned per Toolbar 2's settings.
*   Only one level of toolbar is embedded, in an effort to prevent recursion and maintain performance.
*   The icon, label, and tooltip fields are disabled as they don't do anything for item groups.
*   [Variables](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Variables)
     used in toolbar items in the embedded toolbar resolve based on the props/values in the current note.

* * *

Navigation bars
===============

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jul 3, 2026 · [11 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars/_history)

The **Navigation bars** section, available on phones only, lets you hide Obsidian's mobile navigation bars.

This allows you to reduce redundancy if toolbar items replicate (or enhance upon) navigation bar actions.

You can also add Note Toolbar to the [Editing bar](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#Editing-bar)
.

Top and bottom navigation bar visibility
----------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#top-and-bottom-navigation-bar-visibility)

Completely hide Obsidian's top or bottom navigation bars, and hide items in the bottom navigation bar.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/mobile_navbar_overrides.png "Screenshot of the navigation bar overrides")

Ribbon
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#ribbon)

See [Ribbon](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon)
 for how to customize the ribbon, including adding access to individual toolbars or items.

Editing bar
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#editing-bar)

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/407393904-6a801ce2-62a8-4930-a880-e1f36f5ee3b7.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..fp8W8QLLKwqUDc9xnTAEr0nD9OTVImuyXlcUNPhnt0o)

On mobile, you can also access the current toolbar from Obsidian's mobile toolbar. Here's how to set it up:

1.  In Obsidian's settings on mobile, go to **Toolbar → scroll to the bottom of Manage toolbar options → Add global command**
2.  Select the `Note Toolbar: Open Quick Tools (for current toolbar)` command.

When using that item, it will open a [Quick Tools](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools)
 window that shows the items in the toolbar associated with the current note.

Item Menus
==========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Menus#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Nov 22, 2025 · [4 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Item-Menus/_history)

After selecting `Item Menu`, select an existing toolbar to add as a drop-down menu to your toolbar.

![](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/raw/master/docs/images/example_item_menu.png "Example of using a variable in a URI")

Note

For icons to appear in menus, Obsidian's native menus option must be _disabled_: **Obsidian Settings → Appearance → Native Menus**

Quick Tools
===========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jun 27, 2026 · [38 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools/_history)

Quickly access tools and toolbars wherever you are with the [Quick Tools commands](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Commands#quick-tools-and-toolbar-access)
: `Note Toolbar: Quick tools` and `Note Toolbar: Quick toolbars`.

Tip

Map a hotkey to these commands, or add to your existing toolbars, to access all of your tools.

![Demo of the Quick Toolbars and Quick Tools commands](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/raw/master/docs/images/demo_quick_tools.gif?raw=1)

How it works
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#how-it-works)

Use a [Quick Tools command](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Commands#quick-tools-and-toolbar-access)
 to open one of:

### Quick Toolbars window

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#quick-toolbars-window)

Use `Note Toolbar: Quick toolbars` command to open a window that lists all of your toolbars. Select any _toolbar_ from the list and it will open a _Quick Tools_ window showing only the items in that toolbar.

*   When clicking a toolbar, hold down `⌘ + shift` (on MacOS) / `ctrl + shift` (on Windows) to open the toolbar for editing, versus selecting the toolbar.

### Quick Tools window

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#quick-tools-window)

Use the `Note Toolbar: Quick tools` command to open this window (for the current toolbar), select an _item_ and it will use it as if you triggered it from the toolbar.

*   Duplicates (same label, or tooltip if there's no label, and link or command ID) are not shown in the Quick Tools list.
*   Pressing `Left arrow (←)` or `Backspace` when the search field is empty will navigate back to the _Quick Toolbars_ window (if it was opened from there).
*   Open File items in various views:
    *   use a mouse and [modifier keys ↗](https://help.obsidian.md/User+interface/Tabs#Open+a+link)
         to open in a new tab, split view, or window.
    *   use the keyboard to open in a new tab (`cmd` / `ctrl` + `enter`) or in a split view (`cmd+option` / `ctrl+alt` + `enter`).
*   When clicking, hold down `⌘ + shift` (on MacOS) / `ctrl + shift` (on Windows) to open the item for editing, versus executing the item.
    *   Note: If you edit an item that's a duplicate and change the label (or tooltip if not shown), you will create a new unique entry in the Quick Tools list.

### Notes

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#notes)

*   Items are followed by icons to help identify File, URI, and JavaScript item types. Commands do not have icons.
*   Menus are not shown in the list.
*   Only items set to be visible on the current platform are shown.
*   Both windows can be styled in [Style Settings](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
     under _Quick Tools_.

Tip

Eliminate duplicates in the list by making sure they have the same label or tooltip.

Mobile access
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools#mobile-access)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/mobile_nav_ribbon_menu.png)

Set the ribbon icon (on phones) to open the Quick Tools window, or the Quick Toolbars window. See: [Ribbon button](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Navigation-bars#ribbon-button)

Sharing toolbars
================

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jul 6, 2026 · [33 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars/_history)

Share toolbars and items with a link that you can send to other users.

Sharing toolbars
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#sharing-toolbars)

Right-click (or long-press on mobile) on a toolbar and select the **Share** option, or use the "More" (...) menu in Settings when hovering over a toolbar in the toolbar list.

Tip

If you prefer, you can also [copy a toolbar as a callout](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-callouts-from-toolbars)
 and share those with other users. Just review the _Copy as callout_ settings prior to sharing.

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/375510729-a1d59acb-729c-4017-83d9-99985a920cf9.gif?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..7gbgAGQdLVcDSMd8XdYn9PF5IWprBp0BciB6KzdNsTI)

Sharing items
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#sharing-items)

Edit an item and use **More actions (...) → Share item** option.

Share options
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#share-options)

### Use Obsidian URI option

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#use-obsidian-uri-option)

Toggle this option to change the link to either an `https://` or an `obsidian://` link.

*   `https://` links can be pasted into more places, including chats and discussion forums.
*   `obsidian://` links may have to be copied and pasted first. They can be pasted straight into a browser's address bar, or linked from an Obsidian note.

How sharing works
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#how-sharing-works)

Toolbars and items are shared as Note Toolbar Callouts, encoded in the share link.

See how Note Toolbar [copies to callouts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Creating-callouts-from-toolbars)
, but there are minor differences when sharing as a link:

*   Menu items are shared using their names (versus their IDs), to give the recipient more context as to what the menu was for.
*   A warning message is displayed if the share link exceeds 2,048 characters (i.e., for larger toolbars), which some browsers apparently don't support; Chrome and Safari seem fine though.
*   Note: When pasting long `https://` links directly into Obsidian, the editor seems to divide the link into clickable parts (of 512 characters each). You'll have to put the URL in a markdown link, in order to make it clickable.

What the recipient sees when clicking on a link
-----------------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars#what-the-recipient-sees-when-clicking-on-a-link)

When users click on the link, they're prompted for confirmation and a preview of the toolbar or item.

Once confirmed:

*   The toolbar's settings window will appear.
*   Command items are highlighted if the recipient does not already have the plugin installed _and_ enabled.
    *   If the command looks valid, a link will be shown link to the plugin's Community Plugins page, so the recipient can review and install/enable it if they so choose.
*   Other items may be highlighted if they're invalid.

_Toolbars will still need to be mapped, or its name added to a Note Toolbar property, in order to display the toolbar in their notes._

Templater
=========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Apr 10, 2026 · [55 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater/_history)

Use **Templater** to insert templates, create new notes from specific templates, and to execute Templater commands and files.

*   The [Templater plugin ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=templater-obsidian)
     must be installed _and enabled_.
*   Note Toolbar's _Scripting_ option must be enabled in order to use this feature.

Tip

See the `examples` folder in this repo for [user scripts ↗](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts/Templater)
 and [templates ↗](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Templates)
 that work with Note Toolbar. See also [Zach Young's Templater Snippets ↗](https://zachyoung.dev/posts/templater-snippets/)
.

Use Templater commands in toolbar item fields
---------------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#use-templater-commands-in-toolbar-item-fields)

Use Templater commands in labels, tooltips, and URIs, to create dynamic toolbars.

For example, set your label to `<%tp.date.now("MMM Do")%>` to show today's date. Alternately use this syntax: `{{tp: tp.date.now("MMM Do")}}`

Note that the _entire_ label/tooltip/URI must start with a `<%` and end with a `%>`. If you wish to include a fixed string as part of the output, the expression must output that string.

*   For example, this will not work: `Daily Notes/<% moment(tp.file.title, ... %>`
*   Instead, the command will need to append the string: `<% "Daily Notes/" + moment(tp.file.title, ... %>`

Functions available
-------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#functions-available)

After creating a new `Templater` toolbar item, select from one of the below functions.

Note

When selecting templates, files listed are based on Templater's _Template folder location_ setting.

### `Insert template`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#insert-template)

*   Inserts the provided template in the current file, at the current cursor position.
*   Uses the `append_template_to_active_file` API method.

### `Create new note from template`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#create-new-note-from-template)

*   Creates a new note from the provided template.
*   Optionally specify an output folder and filename (without the `.md` extension). Use a Templater command in this field to create a dynamic filename.
*   Optionally select a command to run after execution, for example: `Files: Reveal current file in navigation`.
*   Uses the `create_new_note_from_template` API method.

### `Execute Templater command`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#execute-templater-command)

*   Executes the provided Templater command and returns the result.
*   The tags `<%` and `%>` are optional.
*   Execute user scripts with `tp.user...`
*   Uses the `parse_template` API function.

_Example command:_

```js
tp.file.creation_date()
```

### `Execute Templater file`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#execute-templater-file)

*   Executes the provided file and returns the result.
*   Make sure you include `tp` in the function's signature in order to use Templater's API within your scripts.
*   Uses the `read_and_parse_template` API method.

_Example file:_

```js
/**
 * Adds a date stamp to the filename of the current file.
 */
module.exports = async function FileRename(tp) {
    tp.file.rename(tp.file.title + ' ' + tp.date.now());
}
```

Note Toolbar Callout support
----------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#note-toolbar-callout-support)

For Note Toolbar Callouts, use these data attributes:

| Function | `data-templater-obsidian` | `data-src` | `data-expr` | `data-dest` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Insert template | `appendTemplate` | template filename | _n/a_ | _n/a_ |
| Create new note from template | `createFrom` | template filename | _n/a_ | output filename |
| Execute Templater command | `parseTemplate` | _n/a_ | templater command | _n/a_ |
| Execute Templater file | `parseTemplateFile` | template filename | _n/a_ | _n/a_ |

Example:

```md
> [!note-toolbar] Templater Toolbar
> - [Create from Template]()<data data-templater-obsidian="createFrom" data-src="Templater/Basic Template.md" data-dest="&lt;%&quot;Basic &quot; + tp.file.last_modified_date(&quot;yyyy-MM-dd&quot;)%&gt;"/>
```

Advanced settings
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#advanced-settings)

### Output callout ID

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#output-callout-id)

Use this to create a callout for where script output can be sent.

See [Executing scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts#where-does-output-go)
, which also covers how errors are handled.

### Focus in editor

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater#focus-in-editor)

After a script is executed, focus is placed in the editor by default. If set to `false`, it won't be.

This is useful for scripts that don't have an impact on the content of your notes, such as opening a menu with the [`ntb.menu` API](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#menu)
.

Custom styling
==============

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Apr 10, 2026 · [58 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling/_history)

If you're comfortable writing CSS, read on; if not, consider using the [Style Settings plugin](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
 to further style your toolbars.

Apply styling to all toolbars (CSS snippets)
--------------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#apply-styling-to-all-toolbars-css-snippets)

Override any aspect of Note Toolbar's styling with [CSS snippets ↗](https://help.obsidian.md/Extending+Obsidian/CSS+snippets)
.

Any modifications done in a CSS snippet will apply to all toolbars, unless you're applying specific classes (see below).

Read about [styling tips](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#-tips)
.

Apply styling to specific toolbars
----------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#apply-styling-to-specific-toolbars)

Using the **Custom** styles section with a CSS snippet, you can define custom classes that you can apply to one or more _specific_ toolbars.

Note

Custom styles are _not_ included in [shared toolbars or copied to callouts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Sharing-toolbars)
.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/styles_settings_custom.png "Styles settings example highlighting the Custom styles section")

### How to use Custom styles

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#how-to-use-custom-styles)

1.  Create a new [CSS snippet file ↗](https://help.obsidian.md/Extending+Obsidian/CSS+snippets)
     in your vault's snippets folder (e.g., `NoteToolbarSnippets.css`). Confirm this file is available _and enabled_, in Obsidian's settings, under **Appearance → CSS snippets**.
    
2.  In the CSS file, make sure it starts with the below, in order to target the toolbar element:
    

```css
.callout[data-callout="note-toolbar"] {

}
```

3.  Add one or more classes to your CSS. Note there should be no space between the `&` and each class name.

```css
.callout[data-callout="note-toolbar"] {

  &.my-custom-class {
    background-color: red !important;
  }

  &.my-other-custom-class {
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    border-color: blue;
  }

}
```

4.  Back in your toolbar's settings, add one or more of the above classes to a toolbar's **Styles → Custom** setting separated by spaces. _Refer also to the above screenshot._ Your changes should now be visible on your toolbar.

    my-custom-class my-other-custom-class
    

In addition, any changes you make to the CSS snippet classes should now be immediately visible on your toolbars.

Apply styling to callouts
-------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#apply-styling-to-callouts)

Add your own styles to [Note Toolbar Callouts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-Callouts)
 with CSS snippets:

1.  Create a new [CSS snippet file ↗](https://help.obsidian.md/Extending+Obsidian/CSS+snippets)
     in your vault's snippets folder, or use the same one in the above example.
    
2.  In the CSS file, make sure it starts with the below, in order to target toolbar callouts:
    

```css
.callout[data-callout="note-toolbar"] {

}
```

3.  Add one or more custom callout styles to your CSS, e.g., `customcallout`. Note there should be no space between the `&` and the new style.

```css
.callout[data-callout="note-toolbar"] {

  &[data-callout-metadata*="customcallout"] {
    background-color: green !important;
  }

}
```

4.  In any callout, just add the style name in the first line of the callout:

```md
> [!note-toolbar|border-even-customcallout]
> - [[Home]]
> ...
```

💡 Tips
-------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#-tips)

*   Some rules may require `!important` to take effect (e.g., `background-color: red !important;`).
*   To style specific items, see [Developer IDs](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs)
    .
*   To style menus, Obsidian's native menus option must be _disabled_: **Settings → Appearance → Native Menus**
*   Consider creating classes that you can apply to more than one toolbar with common styling. However, if you want all your buttons across toolbars to look similar, for example, just override the default button styling.
*   Refer to [`styles.css`](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/blob/master/styles.css)
    , particularly the `body` section, for the core set of variables that can be easily overridden.

### Styling the active file item

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Custom-styling#styling-the-active-file-item)

File items are given a `data-active-file` attribute, if the file you're currently viewing matches the item's filename. This allows you to optionally style a button as if it was a tab. If you'd prefer a different style from the `tab file item` default style, create a CSS snippet such as the following:

```css
.callout[data-callout="note-toolbar"] {
  li[data-active-file] {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--link-color);
    & span.external-link {
      color: var(--link-color);
      filter: unset;
    }
  }
}
```

Ribbon
======

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Jul 10, 2026 · [19 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon/_history)

Use Obsidian's **Ribbon** to access individual toolbars and toolbar items.

Toolbars
--------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#toolbars)

> Available in `1.34+`

In a toolbar's settings, toggle **Add to ribbon**.

When the toolbar is added to the ribbon, the toolbar's icon is used; Note Toolbar's icon is used by default. Select an icon using the advanced settings (⚙️) next to the toolbar's name.

### How the toolbar is displayed

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#how-the-toolbar-is-displayed)

Choose an option under **How to display toolbar** which gives you these options when the ribbon's icon is clicked/tapped:

*   _Floating toolbar_, displays a floating toolbar where the ribbin icon is;
*   _Menu_, opens a menu where the ribbon icon is; or
*   _Quick Tools window_, opens the toolbar as a [Quick Tools](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools)
     window.

Toolbar items
-------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#toolbar-items)

> Available in `1.34+`

In an item's **More options (...)** menu, select **Add to ribbon**.

When an item is added to the ribbon, the item's icon is used; Note Toolbar's icon is used by default.

Notes for toolbars and toolbar items
------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#notes-for-toolbars-and-toolbar-items)

*   To order items in the ribbon, drag and drop (on desktop) or use Obsidian's settings: **Appearance / Interface → Ribbon menu configuration**
*   For convenience on desktop, to edit the ribbon item, right-click on a ribbon icon.
*   Removing toolbars or items from the ribbon will remove them immediately, and they won't be added on restart. However, they may still appear in Obsidian's configuration. On restarting Obsidian, they will no longer show in settings.
*   Deleting toolbars also deletes their items, which will remove them from the ribbon.
*   On tablets, enable the ribbon in Obsidian's settings: **Appearance/Interface → Show ribbon**

Ribbon button 📱
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#ribbon-button-)

> Available in `1.33 and earlier`. Replaced with the above ribbon options in `1.34+`.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/mobile_nav_ribbon_menu.png)

On phones, Note Toolbar can be accessed from Obsidian's **Ribbon button** on the bottom navigation bar. Use this setting to customize what it does when tapped:

*   _Show current toolbar_, shows the toolbar mapped to the current note;
*   _Show selected toolbar_, shows the chosen toolbar;
*   _Show all tools_, opens the [Quick Tools](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools)
     window; or
*   _Show all toolbars_, opens the [Quick Toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Quick-Tools)
     window.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/mobile_nav_ribbon_settings.png)

### Migrating to `1.34+`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#migrating-to-134)

Ribbon access works slightly differently in `1.34+`:

| Option | Do this instead... |
| --- | --- |
| _Show current toolbar_ | Add item with command `Quick tools (for current toolbar)` |
| _Show selected toolbar_ | Open the toolbar's settings and toggle `Add to ribbon` |
| _Show all tools_ | Add item with command `Quick tools` |
| _Show all toolbars_ | Add item with command `Quick toolbars` |

### Quick access ribbon item

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Ribbon#quick-access-ribbon-item)

You can the ribbon button icon with Note Toolbar, for access with one tap, if you don't mind replacing one of your other items:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/mobile_nav_ribbon_bar.png)

To set Note Toolbar as the ribbon button itself:

1.  Go to Obsidian settings: `Appearance → Ribbon menu → Manage`
2.  Set the `Quick access ribbon item` to `Note Toolbar`

Tip

You can still access your other navigation bar / ribbon items by holding your finger down on the Note Toolbar icon (i.e., long-press it). Note that you might be able to add your ribbon items to your toolbar, depending on what commands they provide.

Tip

You can optionally set the toolbar's position to `Hidden / Navigation bar` on mobile, which will _not_ show the toolbar within the note, for a cleaner experience.

Positioning toolbars
====================

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Sep 2, 2026 · [114 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars/_history)

Choose the position of the toolbar, separately for desktop and mobile (i.e., phone and tablet), using each toolbar's **Position** setting.

You can also access toolbars throughout the app, including: in the New tab view, the Navigation bar (on phones), and more. See [Toolbars within the app](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Toolbars-within-the-app)
.

Toolbars can also be shown in [non-markdown files](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#Non-markdown-files)
 such as canvases, PDFs, and video.

Note

Positioning items _within_ a toolbar (e.g., left/right/center) are done when [styling toolbars](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Styling-toolbars)
.

Adjust the Position via the toolbar's settings, or by right-clicking on a toolbar (long press on mobile):

Top navigation
--------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#top-navigation)

> Available in `v1.26+`

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/demo_pos_tabbar.png)

Places a toolbar button at the top of the editor, next to the _Reading/Preview mode_ and _File_ menu buttons.

*   You can right-click on the button (long-press on mobile) to change its settings.
*   Change the icon shown under Note Toolbar's settings: **Other → Icon**.

Top (fixed)
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#top-fixed)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/demo_pos_top_fixed.gif)

Fixes the toolbar to the top of the editor window, above the note's title, regardless of the scroll position.

Below Properties
----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#below-properties)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/demo_pos_below_props.gif)

Places the toolbar below the note's Properties.

Notes:

*   If there are no Properties, the toolbar is generally placed where the properties would be (below your note's title, if they're configured to show). The `Below Properties` option is not shown in Source mode, and in non-Markdown files,
*   Use this position, in combination with the `sticky` style (in Editing/Source mode), to stick the toolbar to the top of the editor view on scroll.
*   Use the Style Settings plugin to shift the toolbar up or down if a theme covers up the toolbar.

Bottom
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#bottom)

Fixes the toolbar at the bottom of the editor window, regardless of the scroll position.

Tip

Adjust distance from the bottom, left/right padding, and border radius using the [Style Settings plugin](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
 or by changing CSS variables.

Notes:

*   Toolbars with breaks have a gap on the right side (equivalent to the size of the wrapped items).

Floating button
---------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#floating-button)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/demo_mobile_floating_button.gif)

Adds a button that floats over your content in the lower left or right corner of the editor. When clicked it displays a menu containing the items in your toolbar.

Notes:

*   Change the toolbar icon in settings.
*   Make adjustments to the button with the [Style Settings plugin](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
    , including the precise position of the button.
*   How toolbar items are shown in the "toolbar menu":
    *   Each item in the menu consists of the item’s icon, the label, or if the label’s blank, the tooltip.

Tip

Use tooltips to add text to in menus, while keeping the toolbar simple, if you would prefer not to use labels. Note that even if the icon or label is set to hidden for both desktop and mobile, it will still be shown in the menu.

### Floating button default item

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#floating-button-default-item)

Set a **Floating button default item** to show an item which will execute when clicked/tapped. To get access to the toolbar's items, right-click on the button (or long-press on mobile).

Tip

Consider using this with a floating button in the ["New tab" view](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Defining-where-to-show-toolbars#show-a-toolbar-in-the-new-tab-view)
 and scripting, to create a convenient launching point for your vault.

Notes:

*   The setting appears only when a floating button position is set for either the desktop or mobile.
*   The icon for the item will be shown if one is set, otherwise it will use the toolbar's icon.
*   Remember that the **Show "Edit toolbar" link in toolbar menus** setting can be enabled to add an item to edit the toolbar, if needed.

Hidden
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#hidden)

Completely hide the toolbar on that platform.

Tip

Set your toolbar to `Hidden` and add Note Toolbar to the nav bar, for a more minimal way to access your toolbars, on mobile.

Other positions
---------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#other-positions)

See [Toolbars within the app](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Toolbars-within-the-app)
 for additional ways to access toolbars including: the New tab view, mobile navigation bar, mobile editing bars, when text is selected, and more.

### File menu

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#file-menu)

_This documentation has been moved [here](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Toolbars-within-the-app)
._

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Positioning-toolbars#new-tab-view)

Accessibility
=============

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Nov 22, 2025 · [45 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility/_history)

I'm committed to ensuring that Note Toolbar is implemented in an accessible way.

Keyboard navigation
-------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility#keyboard-navigation)

Note Toolbar's settings UI is designed to be fully keyboard navigable.

For toolbars, use the command: `Note Toolbar: Focus` to put keyboard focus within the toolbar itself. You can then navigate between items using the arrow keys, and click using `enter` or `spacebar`.

Tip

You can assign a keyboard shortcut to this command in Obsidian: `Settings > Hotkeys`.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/master/docs/images/demo_focus_command.gif "Demo of the focus command, which allows keyboard navigation within the toolbar")

Colors
------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility#colors)

Toolbar items use Obsidian's color variables. If you require higher contrast, use a theme, the [Style Settings plugin](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Style-Settings-plugin-support)
, or a snippet that sets these CSS variables with higher-contrasting colors:

*   item background color (on hover): `--cg-nt-item-bg-color-hover`
*   item text color: `--cg-nt-item-text-color`
*   item text color (on hover): `--cg-nt-item-text-color-hover`
*   toolbar background color: `--cg-nt-tbar-bg-color`

For screen readers
------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility#for-screen-readers)

Setting tooltips for your toolbar items will set the `aria-label` attribute for each item in the list.

How can I improve?
------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Accessibility#how-can-i-improve)

If you spot any issues or identify any improvements that would make this plugin (including its settings windows) more accessible, please [log an issue](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
.

JS Engine
=========

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Apr 10, 2026 · [46 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine/_history)

Use **JS Engine** to execute JavaScript with this item type.

*   Install and enable the [JS Engine plugin ↗](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=js-engine)
     to execute JavaScript from Note Toolbar.
*   Note Toolbar's _Scripting_ option must be enabled in order to use this feature.

Tip

Example scripts that work with Note Toolbar can be found [in this folder ↗](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/tree/master/examples/Scripts/JsEngine)

Use JavaScript expressions in any toolbar item
----------------------------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#use-javascript-expressions-in-any-toolbar-item)

Use JavaScript expressions in labels, tooltips, and URIs, to create dynamic toolbars.

For example, set your label to `{{js: return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}}` to show today's date, right in your toolbar.

Functions available
-------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#functions-available)

After creating a new `JS Engine` toolbar item, select from one of the below functions.

### `Evaluate JavaScript`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#evaluate-javascript)

*   Interprets the provided JavaScript expression (which can be multiple lines) and returns the result.

_Expression example:_

```js
console.log("👋 Hello console!");
new Notice("👋 Hello notice!");
```

### `Execute JavaScript file`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#execute-javascript-file)

*   Executes the provided script, optionally putting output in the provided Output callout. File path should be relative to your vault's root.
*   Uses the `internal.executeFile` API method.

_JavaScript file example:_

```js
console.log("👋 Hello console!");
new Notice("👋 Hello notice!");
return "👋 Hello note!";
```

_JavaScript file with markdown rendering:_

```js
return engine.markdown.create('*test*'); // must use Output callout ID for this to render into
```

The JS Engine Markdown Builder works as well. See the [JS Engine documentation ↗](https://github.com/mProjectsCode/obsidian-js-engine-plugin#examples)

#### Input parameters

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#input-parameters)

If input parameters are passed to the script, such as:

```ts
param1: "value1", param2: 123
```

...they can be accessed within the script like so:

```ts
if (input) {
  ({param1, param2} = input)
  console.log(param1); // "value1"
}
```

### `Import and execute`

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#import-and-execute)

*   Imports the provided JavaScript file, then executes a function within it. File path should be relative to your vault's root.
*   Parameters can be passed in JSON format, e.g., `{ "name": "Chris" }`. See above for how to use them.
*   ⚠️ Note that the JavaScript file is only imported _once_. You may have to restart Obsidian in order to pick up changes.
*   Uses the `importJs` API method.

_JavaScript file with function and arguments example:_

```js
export function Hello(engine, args) {
    console.log(`👋 Hello ${args['name']}`);
    new Notice(`👋 Hello ${args['name']}`);
}
```

Note Toolbar Callout support
----------------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#note-toolbar-callout-support)

For Note Toolbar Callouts, use these data attributes:

| Function | `data-js-engine` | `data-src` | `data-expr` | `data-func` | `data-args` | `data-callout` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Evaluate JavaScript | `evaluate` | _n/a_ | expression | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | callout ID (_optional_) |
| Execute JavaScript | `exec` | JavaScript filename | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | _n/a_ | callout ID (_optional_) |
| Import and execute JavaScript | `importExec` | JavaScript filename | _n/a_ | function name (_optional_) | arguments (_optional_) | _n/a_ |

Example:

```md
> [!note-toolbar] JS Engine Toolbar
> - [Hello World with JS Engine]()<data data-js-engine="exec" data-src="Scripts/JsEngine/HelloWorld.js"/>
```

Advanced settings
-----------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#advanced-settings)

### Output callout ID

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#output-callout-id)

Use this to create a callout for where script output can be sent.

See [Executing scripts](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Executing-scripts#where-does-output-go)
, which also covers how errors are handled.

### Focus in editor

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/JS-Engine#focus-in-editor)

After a script is executed, focus is placed in the editor by default. If set to `false`, it won't be.

This is useful for scripts that don't have an impact on the content of your notes, such as opening a menu with the [`ntb.menu` API](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Note-Toolbar-API#menu)
.

* * *

Developer IDs
=============

[Jump to bottom](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#wiki-pages-box)

Chris Gurney edited this page Apr 10, 2026 · [9 revisions](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs/_history)

A developer ID is a unique identifier that that is assigned to every toolbar and item.

These IDs can be used to uniquely style toolbars or items, or reference them from the API, without worrying if their names might change.

Get a Developer ID
------------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#get-a-developer-id)

### Toolbar IDs

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#toolbar-ids)

1.  Go to Note Toolbar's main settings (in `v1.27` or later), hover over a toolbar.
2.  **More options (...) → Copy developer ID**.

### Item IDs

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#item-ids)

For **toolbar items**, go to each item's settings, and use **More actions (...) → Copy developer ID**.

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/17337703/572651050-d3a3f025-d3bd-40ca-96ff-af0ab4f187c8.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ysWC-4bbV8xB0RFikfjPKOtCobIIhNkg1Ya9hIGcnmI)

CSS example
-----------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#css-example)

Color a specific toolbar icon using a CSS snippet:

```css
/* for IDs that start with a letter */
body span#a7cae1b8-ee47-4b88-af17-5084d46393b5 svg { color: #c16e67; }
/* for IDs that start with a number, escape the first character; see note below */
body span#\36 5b1545c-6dd8-496c-9ae9-5f613d6b3f40 svg { color: #c16e67; }
```

Note

Escape the first character with a `\3` _and a space_ **if the ID starts with a number** as per the above example:

> `6` → `\36`

You don't need to do this if the ID starts with a letter. All IDs in `v1.30.08` and later for newly-generated toolbars and items start with a letter.

API examples
------------

[](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Developer-IDs#api-examples)

```js
// update this item's icon
const item = ntb.getItem('112c7ed3-d5c2-4750-b95d-75bc84e23513');
item.setIcon('alert');

// or fetch the HTML element (for non-floating-button toolbars)
const itemEl = activeDocument.getElementById('112c7ed3-d5c2-4750-b95d-75bc84e23513');
```
